notes: Paper-alignment experiment: the PCBnet baseline (mAP 94.54%) reports YOLOv11; this run trains yolo11s from COCO initialization on the same recipe as v3_big.

Scale note: use 'yolo11s.yaml' (with the s suffix) — a bare 'yolo11.yaml' silently parses at scale n; the s suffix selects the 9.5M-parameter s scale from the yaml's scales dict (verified: 9.5M params, 3 detect layers).
No warm start from v1/v2: v8 -> v11 modules (C2f vs C3k2, C2PSA) do not transfer; ClassNameTransferTrainer copies no classification rows, cv2 box-regression rows transfer only where shapes match.
Same data, split, augmentation and schedule as detector_training_v3.json so the backbone comparison stays clean.
If yolo11s wins over v3_nano and v3_big, consider a custom v11-P2 yaml as a follow-up; the installed ultralytics only ships an official P2 variant for v8.
VRAM estimate ~4.5-5 GB at imgsz 1536 batch 4 amp on the 8 GB card; drop to --batch 2 if OOM.
